english: Mmm...
Is something wrong, Soniko-san?
Oh, Tefa-san, everyone —\nyou're all just SO cute...\nI couldn't help staring.
W-what's gotten into you, all of a sudden?
Outfit combos I've never worn myself —\nI'm learning so much!
Clothes?
I get it, I totally get it, Soniko-chan!
Wah! Ehehe, right~!
Yeah yeah,\nRemu-san, baring those beautiful legs to the open air without a second thought,
that bikini armor!
B-beautiful legs...?\nI've never even thought about that...
Tiffania's elven outfit,\nboosting her presence 200%!
P-presence?
It's a super captivating outfit, right!
Wah!\nThank you for speaking\nwith such passion!
Riko-chan's frilly uniform\nis super cute too!
I'm already a college student,\nso I never get to wear a uniform...\nI'm a little jealous~.
You'd look good in anything, Soniko-chan.
Yes, you'd look wonderful.
Wah, you flatter me!
Ehehe, I do a lot of photoshoot work,\nso hearing that from you\nreally makes me happy!
(Beautiful legs, presence... s-so jealous, desuu~!)
I wear doggie ears and kitty ears\nfor shoots too~!
(Yeah! I wanna wear ears too, desuu~)
Don't forget the bunny either!
(Bunny's cute too, desuu~!)
U-um... what are you doing here...?
Huh...?
Crouching over there like that — is your stomach hurting or something?
Kufufu, were you eavesdropping~?
I-I was NOT eavesdropping, desuu!\nIt's not like I want beautiful legs or dog ears or anything, desuu...\nokay I do. No I don't, desuu!
...Haha, she's totally lost it.
Don't be shy, come on over here.
Let's all\ndo a fashion show together!
Wah!\nI wanna try on everyone's outfits too!
M-me too, desuu~!\nI wanna try on Tiffania-san's outfit,\ndesuu~!!
Let's... not do that...
